title: Equal changes, different slopes
hook: Two stated cases: explore an explicitly asymmetric response rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How an explicitly asymmetric response rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Difference, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare an explicitly asymmetric response rule in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
